results.title: EdgeAura
results.summary:
EdgeAura transforms your device's visual experience with stunning edge glow effects and dynamic live wallpapers. Make your phone stand out with a beautiful, customizable aura of light that elegantly outlines your screen's edges. This immersive glow effect floats over your other apps and reacts to your activities, including incoming calls, creating a uniquely vibrant and personalized look for your device.

Key Features:

· Dynamic Edge Glow: Enjoy a smooth, colorful glow that frames your screen. Customize the color, width, and intensity of the light to perfectly match your style and wallpaper.
· Floating Overlay Effect: The elegant glow effect works on top of your other applications, providing a continuous and immersive visual experience without interfering with normal phone use.
· Incoming Call Alert: The edges of your screen light up with your chosen color when you receive a call, offering a visually striking and modern notification alert.
· Extensive Live Wallpaper Collection: Discover and apply a wide variety of high-quality, animated live wallpapers from our regularly updated library to refresh your home screen and lock screen instantly.

Important Note on Accessibility Service Permission:

To provide the floating edge glow and incoming call detection features, EdgeAura requires the use of the Android Accessibility Service (AccessibilityService API).

We solemnly declare that this permission is used SOLELY for the core visual functionality of our app. It is strictly used to:

· Detect screen content and application windows to correctly draw the glow effect around the edges.
· Identify incoming call events to trigger the screen edge lighting.

Our app does NOT and will NEVER:

· Collect, transmit, or store any of your personal data, text, or passwords.
· Perform any remote audio recording.
· Change any system settings without your explicit consent.
· Prevent you from disabling or uninstalling the app.
· Interact with or manipulate other apps in any deceptive or unauthorized way.

Your privacy and device security are our top priorities. The Accessibility Service is a powerful tool, and we are committed to using it responsibly and transparently only for its intended purpose: to deliver a beautiful and innovative visual experience for you.

Download EdgeAura now and give your phone a brilliant, glowing personality!

results.title: WhatsApp Messenger
results.summary:
WhatsApp from Meta is a FREE messaging and video calling app. It’s used by over 2B people in more than 180 countries. It’s simple, reliable, and private, so you can easily keep in touch with your friends and family. WhatsApp works across mobile and desktop even on slow connections, with no subscription fees*.


Private messaging across the world

Your personal messages and calls to friends and family are end-to-end encrypted. No one outside of your chats, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them.


Simple and secure connections, right away
All you need is your phone number, no user names or logins. You can quickly view your contacts who are on WhatsApp and start messaging.

High quality voice and video calls
Make secure video and voice calls with up to 32 people for free*. Your calls work across mobile devices using your phone’s Internet service, even on slow connections.

Group chats to keep you in contact
Stay in touch with your friends and family. End-to-end encrypted group chats let you share messages, photos, videos and documents across mobile and desktop.

Stay connected in real time
Share your location with only those in your individual or group chat, and stop sharing at any time. Or record a voice message to connect quickly.


Share daily moments through Status
Status allows you to share text, photos, video and GIF updates that disappear after 24 hours. You can choose to share status posts with all your contacts or just selected ones.

Use WhatsApp on your Wear OS watch to continue conversations, reply to messages, and take calls - all from your wrist. And, leverage tiles and complications to easily access your chats and send voice messages.
